Merino wool tee

Search

A lightweight merino tee that regulates temperature in both directions, machine washable at thirty degrees, and cut from a single-origin wool the mill traces back to the farm. The tee ships from the warehouse the same day when the order is placed before three in the afternoon, and returns are free within thirty days for any reason at all.

Sizing runs true to the chest measurement printed on the label. Customers between two sizes usually keep the smaller one because the knit relaxes after the first wash, which the care card in the box also explains in three short lines.
